import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('cohort_metabolites.csv')
df = df.dropna(subset=['t2d', 'ckd', 'egfr'])
metabolites = df.filter(regex='^met_')

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X = df[metabolite_cols + covariate_cols]
y = df['t2d_ckd_comorbidity'].astype(int)
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

cv = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
for train_idx, test_idx in cv.split(X_scaled, y):
    model.fit(X_scaled[train_idx], y.iloc[train_idx])

from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc

prob = model.predict_proba(X_scaled[test_idx])[:, 1]
fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y.iloc[test_idx], prob)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.figure(figsize=(4, 3), dpi=300)
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f'AUC={roc_auc:.2f}')
plt.xlabel('False positive rate')
plt.ylabel('True positive rate')
plt.legend(frameon=False)
plt.savefig('roc_curve.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
